## Details

<a id="draw_fighter"></a>
### [`draw_fighter`](../../../../src/fighter/draw.asm#L6) `$8B73`

*routine*

Draws the pose buffer of fighter $99 into the work bitmap at its column $71,x. Pixel pairs %00 are transparent. After a beaten fighter ($af bit 7), it uses the clipped version that draws only columns below 40. Both versions draw only 62 of the 63 lines of the buffer.

- **Called from:** [`animate_fighter`](animate.md#animate_fighter)
